text:
emma (People Ops): Quick thread with clarifications for the upcoming performance cycle. Self-assessments open today, due Tue May 12 23:59 PT. Calibration week: May 13-17. Manager final submissions due by Fri May 17.

omar (Eng Manager): Thanks Emma. Are peer feedbacks required or opt-in?

emma (People Ops): Peer feedback is optional. If teams use it, keep it short (2 bullets). There's a one-question peer form for cross-team collaborators.

lee (IC): If someone joins during the review window (e.g., started May 1), do we rate them?

emma (People Ops): Policy: hires <30 days get "No formal rating" but add onboarding + ramp notes in the manager comments field so hiring and L&D have context.

tal (Recruiting): Can we add a mandatory field for "Ramp plan" to the manager form? Hiring ops relies on that.

emma (People Ops): Done — added an "Onboarding & Ramp" optional field. Please be concise.

omar (Eng Manager): One request: timezone-friendly Eng calibration block? Our APAC folks struggle to join afternoon PT meetings.

emma (People Ops): Srini offered to reserve a late-afternoon PT / morning APAC slot May 15 15:30-17:00 PT if that helps. We'll publish calendar invites shortly.

lee (IC): Extension policy? I have a report off for surgery during calibration week.

emma (People Ops): Extensions allowed for medical/parental leave. Use the extension request form and cc your pplops partner. Max 3 business days per person; emergency approvals are fast-tracked. Link in the guide.

omar (Eng Manager): How will final ratings be communicated to ICs? Automated email?

peopleops-bot: After managers submit final ratings, an autogenerated summary email (rating + manager comments) will be sent to each direct report within 72 business hours. Managers: confirm desired wording in the comments field before submit.

emma (People Ops): Manager checklist snippet (copy into invite):

```
Subject: Calibration Team Name
Agenda: 1) Context (5m) 2) Borderline cases (40m) 3) Finalize ratings + notes (15m)
Prep: scoring spreadsheet, examples for clarity
```

lee (IC): Thanks. Where's the self-assessment template?

emma (People Ops): In the Performance Guide: TL;DR: 3 bullets: accomplishments (with metrics), top impact example (link), development goals (~200-400 words).

omar (Eng Manager): Filed an extension for one report. Thanks for fast-track note.

emma (People Ops): Got the form, Omar. Will confirm by EOD tomorrow. Ping me or DM for any edge cases. :wave:
